$comment: Photo pack curation (source: the team's photo zip, kept untouched in data-raw/photos/).
`npm run photos` turns every listed file into small local WebP images; `npm run data` attaches them
to the machines and to the timeline moments named in `events`. Moments without a photo borrow
another photo of the same machine (never the one on the neighbouring moment).
Captions describe what is visible in the picture — they are not used as mission facts.
Images are listed best-first: the first one is the Cosmic Card photo.

surveyor-3.note: The pack's own `s3` folder shows other missions (see `excluded`), so Surveyor 3 uses the Surveyor pictures from the `apolo 12` folder.

Tall Apollo-programme poster: far too tall for the photo frame and unreadable when shrunk.
Shows the Moon buggy, which (per the data) first flew on Apollo 15 — not Apollo 11.
Carries a third-party (Science Photo Library) watermark.
Shows a command module in a museum, not the lunar module Falcon.
Cockpit/hatch close-up that cannot be identified as Apollo 15.
Appears to be a Mariner probe, not Viking.
Shows a later six-wheeled Mars rover, not Viking 1.
Shows a satellite above Earth, not Pathfinder.
Appears to be the InSight lander, not Pathfinder.
Appears to be a Mariner probe, not Pathfinder.
Shows small cube-shaped spacecraft, not Pathfinder.
Unclear star-streak image that cannot be identified.

relatedFill.$comment: A timeline moment with no photo of its own borrows a RELATED photo of the same world (Moon / Mars) from the gallery, never one its timeline already shows; captioned 'Related photo'. Listed by pack file, best first; '*moon' / '*mars' = then any other machine's photo of that world. A real moment photo (data-raw/photos-new/) always replaces it.
